svg.text: RSE Cloud Cybersecurity — Azure Deployment Architecture
Generated from the Pulumi program (infra/) · consolidation branch
RStudio, VS Code & Chrome apt repos,
All other outbound traffic is denied.
Administrator -> Bastion public IP (HTTPS 443) -> private RDP/SSH tunnel into the VM (no public IP on the VM).
Fixed IP 193.60.220.253 -> Firewall public IP -> DNAT rule forwards SSH:22 to the VM's private IP (narrower demo path).
VM outbound -> UDR (0.0.0.0/0) forces traffic via the Firewall -> allowed only to the FQDN allow-list; everything else is denied.
VM's managed identity (Storage Blob Data Reader) mounts the container with BlobFuse2, over the storage account's private endpoint.
Azure Monitor Agent on the VM -> Data Collection Endpoint (private) -> Data Collection Rule -> Log Analytics workspace, via the AMPLS private endpoint.
Log Analytics metrics feed two Metric Alerts (CPU > 90%, memory > 75%) -> Action Group -> email notification.
